selection: Five purposively selected positive chunks and three negative chunks; frozen before candidate outputs were inspected. Not representative or held out.

cases.reason: ARES page 7 explicitly says RAGAS uses GPT-3.5 as its judge.
ARES page 8 explicitly names the Facebook RAG model, its DPR retriever, and BART. RAG is an accepted bare-name spelling within the same quote.
Jina v3 page 4 figure caption explicitly says the architecture is based on XLM-RoBERTa; surrounding figure text is noisy.
E5 page 7 says BERT-FTbase initializes from BERTbase. This draft interprets initialization as BASED_ON; the same fine-tuning data does not mean it uses E5 as a component.
Sentence-BERT page 1 defines Sentence-BERT (SBERT) as a modification of pretrained BERT. The later runtime comparison does not imply a component relation with RoBERTa.
Generic batch size, learning rate, and model size words are not named entities. Previously inspected in the cue-filter trial, so this is a known development failure.
BEIR page 2 compares classes of methods against BM25 without naming a supported pair of entities in the ontology.
Sentence-BERT page 1 describes BERT computation cost and unsuitability for tasks. Unsuitability is not a positive TARGETS assertion.
